title: Animation Director Studio
description: The user controls an animation director studio where a Fox and CesiumMan perform choreographed routines on a stage. The user sequences animation clips, adjusts playback speed, triggers synchronized transitions, and blends between actions to compose a final performance loop.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an Animation Director Studio. Load Fox.glb and CesiumMan.glb using GLTFLoader. Place both models on a flat circular stage (radius 5, dark gray MeshStandardMaterial). Position the Fox on the left and CesiumMan on the right, facing each other at roughly 3 units apart. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 4, 10) looking at the stage center. Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light from above-right (intensity 1.2) casting shadows. Enable shadow maps on the renderer.

Extract all AnimationClips from both models using THREE.AnimationMixer. Create a control panel (HTML overlay, bottom of screen) with these interactions: (1) A dropdown for Fox animation clip selection that plays the chosen clip. (2) A dropdown for CesiumMan animation clip selection that plays the chosen clip. (3) A shared playback speed slider (range 0.1 to 3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0) that sets timeScale on both mixers simultaneously. (4) A 'Sync Start' button that stops both animations and restarts them simultaneously from time 0. (5) A 'Crossfade Fox' button that crossfades the Fox from its current action to the next available clip over 1 second using crossFadeTo. (6) A 'Crossfade CesiumMan' button that does the same for CesiumMan. (7) A 'Mirror Mode' toggle checkbox that, when enabled, sets CesiumMan's mixer timeScale to the negative of Fox's effective timeScale so CesiumMan plays in reverse relative to Fox. (8) A 'Loop Mode' toggle that switches all active actions between THREE.LoopRepeat and THREE.LoopOnce with clampWhenFinished true.

Validate that speed slider values stay within bounds. Validate that crossfade only triggers when at least two clips exist. Display the current animation time of each mixer as text labels updating each frame. Use OrbitControls for camera interaction. The animation loop must call update(delta) on both mixers every frame using the THREE.Clock delta.
